title: AprilAire Humidifier Control Humidistat

writeup: Woot has a new AprilAire 56 automatic whole-house humidifier control with the outdoor temperature sensor included for $31.73. HVACDirect has the matching model 56, a 24V AutoTrac humidistat controller with one ready to ship, at $119.95. Appliance Factory Parts also has part 56, quantity one, at $183.62. That is about 73 percent below HVACDirect and saves roughly $88. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
